faq_heading: Chilliwack houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Chilliwack house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 55 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $1,140,000, with the middle half between $1,077,450 and $1,355,000. Every Chilliwack detached house had a median of $884,300.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Chilliwack?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 55 Chilliwack houses sold with a legal suite and 150 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $947,500.

faq.q: Can a Chilliwack lot have a suite and a coach house?
faq.a: No. The City allows one accessory dwelling unit per lot, so a legal suite leaves no room for a coach house or garden suite on the same lot.

faq.q: How is a Chilliwack suite measured?
faq.a: It has to be under both 90 square metres and 40% of the building’s habitable floor space, inside a building with a single principal dwelling unit.

faq.q: Which Chilliwack neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Eastern Hillsides had 17 legal-suite sales, Sardis South 14 and Garrison Crossing 6 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Chilliwack houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 32 days at a median, closing at 98.6% of list, with 18% over the list price.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Chilliwack and Sardis that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Sardis South (146), Promontory (78), Chilliwack Proper East (64), Eastern Hillsides (56) and Chilliwack Proper West (43). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 638 detached houses that closed in Chilliwack between November 1 and August 31, 205 (32%) had a suite: 55 legal and 150 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $1,140,000, 29% more than the $884,300 median for every Chilliwack house.

blocks.text: The typical legal-suite house sits on 4,632 sq ft, against 6,174 sq ft for all Chilliwack houses. It has 3,258 square feet of floor area, against 2,349. 100% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 34% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 2,567 square feet and a median $947,500.

Alongside suites, 23 Chilliwack houses had lane access, at a median of $903,000; 12 were marked as a coach or laneway house at $1,326,500; 17 had a second residence on the lot. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: Chilliwack allows one accessory dwelling unit on each lot where the zone permits, and that unit can be a secondary suite, a coach house or a garden suite. A legal suite therefore rules out a coach house on the same lot.

A suite has to be under both 90 square metres and 40% of the building’s habitable floor space, inside a building with one principal dwelling unit. Because both limits apply, a small house can reach the 40% ceiling long before 90 square metres. Garden suites go up to 100 square metres.

Under the Secondary Suites Policy a suite can be rented in any single detached dwelling regardless of zone, provided it has a building permit, meets the BC Building and Fire Code and current flood protection rules, and does not sit below the flood construction level. Bylaw 5395, adopted June 18, 2024, allows 3 to 4 units inside the urban growth boundary.
Before you offer on a Chilliwack house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Chilliwack permit and final inspection for the suite. 150 of the 205 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.

Ask where the suite sits against the flood construction level. New suites below it are not permitted under the Floodplain Regulation Bylaw, so a basement suite built before the current rules needs its history checked.

Measure the suite against the limit of the lesser of 40% of the habitable space and 90 square metres (969 square feet). On the median Chilliwack legal-suite house of 3,258 square feet, 40% comes to about 1,300 square feet.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 32 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $947,500 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $1,140,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
